reference_text:
Wheat, 
oats and potatoes are perhaps the-most satisfactory arable crops; 
swedes and turnips are apt to suffer from ‘ finger and toe ’ disease, 
unless liming is liberal

actual.answer: Wheat, oats and potatoes are perhaps the most satisfactory arable crops grown in the soils of the Coal Measures [E1].

evidences.doc_title: The Geology of the Country Around Holmfirth and Glossop (excerpt)
evidences.text:
8 GEOLOGY OF HOLMFIRTH AND GLOSSOP :
The soils of the Coal Measures are on the whole better than
those of the Millstone Grits, though they suffer from the same
lack of lime. The shales often give a heavy clay soil, which is
mostly under grass, but the sandstones give lighter loams. Wheat,
oats and potatoes are perhaps the-most satisfactory arable crops;
swedes and turnips are apt to suffer from ‘ finger and toe ’ disease,
unless liming is liberal.'

question: What is the thickness range of the Shale Grit in the southern part of the Sheet?
reference_text:
The Shale Grit forms a wide spread on the moors in the 
southern part of the Sheet, where it is 450 to 550 feet thick

actual.answer: The Shale Grit is 450 to 550 feet thick in the southern part of the Sheet. [E1]

evidences.doc_title: The Geology of the Country Around Holmfirth and Glossop (excerpt)
evidences.text:
General Stratigraphy
The Shale Grit forms a wide spread on the moors in the
southern part of the Sheet, where it is 450 to 550 feet thick. It is
also exposed in the valleys of the Etherow and Tame. In the
south it consists of grits and sandstones with frequent thin sandy
shale beds and less frequent thicker shale beds; in Longdendale
the exposed part of the series consists of thicker and more massive
grits, but the exposures in the Tame valley show the beds to be more
like those in the south.

question: 根据这份简介，Iron Maiden 是哪一年在什么地方组建的？
reference_text: 1975年在伦敦东部的 Leyton 组建。

actual.answer: Iron Maiden（铁娘子乐队）由贝斯手及主要创作者 Steve Harris 于1975年在伦敦东部的 Leyton 组建。[E1]

evidences.doc_title: Iron Maiden 铁娘子乐队公开简介
section_path: Iron Maiden 铁娘子乐队公开简介
evidences.text:
公开背景
Iron Maiden（铁娘子乐队）是英国重金属乐队，由贝斯手及主要创作者 Steve Harris 于1975年在伦敦东部的 Leyton 组建。
乐队是英国重金属新浪潮的重要代表。其音乐和歌词涉及历史、文学、战争、神话及科幻等题材。
同名首张录音室专辑于1980年发行；1982年的 The Number of the Beast 是其早期重要作品。这里介绍的是公开音乐背景，不包含 Chinook 销售排名或当代巡演收入。

question: 根据中文数据字典，customer.country 和 invoice.billing_country 分别表示什么？
answer: customer.country 是客户所在地国家；invoice.billing_country 是发票账单地址国家，两个业务含义应分别保留。
reference_text: customer.country 表示客户所在地国家。invoice.billing_country 表示发票账单地址国家。

actual.answer: customer.country 表示客户所在地国家 [E1][E8]；invoice.billing_country 表示发票账单地址国家 [E1][E2]。两者是不同字段，不可直接互换 [E2]。

### customer
客户及其所在地、联系方式、销售支持员工
| 字段 | 数据类型 | 可为空 | 中文说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| customer_id | integer | 否 | 客户编号 |
| first_name | character varying(40) | 否 | 名字 |
| last_name | character varying(20) | 否 | 姓氏 |
| company | character varying(80) | 是 | 客户公司名称，可为空 |
| address | character varying(70) | 是 | 所在地街道地址 |
| city | character varying(40) | 是 | 所在地城市 |
| state | character varying(40) | 是 | 所在地州或省，可为空 |
| country | character varying(40) | 是 | 所在地国家，使用原始英文标准值，例如 USA、Brazil |
